stem: Which of the following is NOT stated in the notice?

options.label: A
options.text: The library closes at 4 p.m. on Saturdays.

options.label: B
options.text: The notice is about Saturday hours.

options.label: C
options.text: The library opens at 8 a.m. on Sundays.

evidence: The Westbridge Community Library closes at 4 p.m. on Saturdays.
reasoning: The notice states the Saturday closing time and the page title gives Saturday hours; no Sunday opening time is stated.

option_reasoning.A: The notice states this closing time.
option_reasoning.B: The page title names Saturday hours.
option_reasoning.C: No Sunday opening time appears in the notice.
